notes:
I matched all 65 stations: 62 to a Findlay 1887 row and 3 to null. The nulls are Fair Isle (no light until 1892) and Hynish Signal Tower (a signal station, not a light), both of which have kind 'other', and the North Carr light-vessel... no — North Carr has a row; the third null does not exist. Correction: 2 nulls (Fair Isle, Hynish), 63 rows. I checked every match against Findlay's latitude and longitude and against the reports' coast order. All positions are plausible, and no station needed an extra_rows entry, because Findlay prints each multi-light station (Pentland Skerries, Isle of May, Pladda, Lamlash, Girdleness, Stornoway) as one row.

Please check:
1. North Carr L.V. (p63r25): Findlay 1887 calls the light-vessel only 'proposed' (dated 1887), but the reports list a 'Carr Rock Light-ship' from 1885. Find out when it was actually stationed, and whether the 1885–86 returns came from the vessel or from someone else. The row has no character of its own; 'fixed bright' appears only in the description.
2. Hoy Sound: hoy-low and hoy-high share p65r23. Part 1 is the high light and part 2 the low light. The row gives one position for both, so if the project needs separate positions it will need another source.
3. Arnish Point: the Stornoway row p66r13 has three parts. The station is part 1, the revolving light on Arnish Point. The reports' '(2 Lights)' presumably counts the reflected beacon light (part 2) as well.
4. Names that could be confused: Fladda (Phladda Island, Scarba Sound) vs Pladda (Arran); Isle Ornsay (Findlay 'Oronsay Island', Sleat Sound); Sanda (Kintyre) vs Sanday (Orkney, the Start Point light); Corran Point filed under 'Loch Eil'; Scurdie Ness filed as MONTROSE NESS rather than Montrose Harbour.
5. Ushenish's neighbours ('Island Glass < > Monach Island') disagree with Monach's ('Island Ghlais < > Ushenish'). So the reports printed these two in a different order in different years. This does not affect the matches.
6. St Abb's Head, Fidra and Inchkeith are on page 45, under the 'ENGLAND / SCOTLAND' running head, so a filter on country = SCOTLAND alone would drop them.
